title: Is There a Risk Premium in the Stock Lending Market? Evidence from Equity Options
one_line: Using option-implied borrowing fees, the risk premium for borrowing-fee uncertainty is small and does not predict fee-adjusted short-selling returns — so fee risk doesn't explain short-selling returns.

findings.statement: Fee risk does not predict fee-adjusted short returns.

reported_results.headline: Using option-implied borrowing fees, the risk premium for borrowing-fee uncertainty is small and does not predict fee-adjusted short-selling returns — so fee risk doesn't explain short-selling returns.

data_fit: Single-stock study — not testable on our ES/NQ data.
